comment: Source read at commit f6cf8d6, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1. The panel letters both V/Oct inputs EXP CV and gives both modulation columns to each oscillator; the maker's parameter names say which knob is an attenuator (0 to 1) and which an attenuverter (-1 to +1), and the panel marks the attenuverters with a minus and a plus. The clock and data oscillator frequency parameters are configured as 2 to the power of the value in Hertz, -5 to 15 (DigitalChaoticSystem.cpp:52). The module is monophonic throughout.
